elsewhere.note: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic, and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.
because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength…
Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.
Punishing them often in all the synagogues, I tried to make them blaspheme. Being exceedingly enraged against them, I persecuted them even to foreign cities.
Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you, and was hindered so far, that I might have some fruit among you also…
We have sent with them our brother, whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which…
For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,
May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,
